title: Shenling Tongqiao powder targets TGF-beta1/Smad-Wnt/beta-catenin axis to suppress epithelial-mesenchymal transition in chronic rhinosinusitis.
authors: Liu, Kai; Zeng, Hui; Zhu, Xiao; Deng, Hao; Deng, Wei; Li, Sixin; Zhu, Yaxian; Bin, Ji; Lu, Shuai; Wu, Wenke; Wu, Qi; Liao, Jun; Hu, Ge; Chang, Wei; Ying, Yekui; Wang, Ying; Zhu, Zhenhua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对慢性鼻窦炎上皮间质转化的调控，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS), a prevalent upper respiratory inflammatory disorder, remains challenging in clinical management due to the high recurrence rates. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) pathogenesis theory posits that CRS primarily stems from deficiency syndromes involving pulmonary and splenic dysfunction. Shenling Tongqiao Powder (SLTQP), a formulated herbal preparation, has demonstrated clinical efficacy in enhancing pulmonary-splenic function and CRS symptom alleviation. But its underlying pharmacological mechanisms require systematic elucidation. METHODS: Nasal mucosa of nasal septum deviation and CRS without nasal polyp (CRSsNP) patients were collected for histopathological analysis in epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). The rat model of CRS was established using Staphylococcus aureus while the body weight, the number of nose-scratching and sneezing were recorded. Sinus inflammation was evaluated by computed tomography (CT) scanning. Histopathological staining, Reverse Transcription Quantitative Real-Time Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-qPCR) and western blot were applied for assessment of TGF-beta1/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and EMT in rat and cell model. Inflammatory factors of rat nasal lavage solution and serum were analyzed by ELISA. LC-MS/MS was used for analysis of SLTQP decoction and pharmaceutic serum. The energy between these molecules and TGF-beta1/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin was calculated by molecular docking, the direct binding affinity was confirmed and quantified via surface plasmon resonance (SPR). RESULTS: Histopathological analysis revealed marked EMT elevation in nasal mucosa specimens from CRSsNP patients. SLTQP administration significantly attenuated EMT progression and suppressed nasal inflammatory responses in CRS rat models, likely mediated via concurrent inhibition of TGF-beta1/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling cascades. Phytochemical profiling via liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) characterized both the native SLTQP decoction components and their bioactive metabolites in systemic circulation. Notably, molecular docking analyses predicted and SPR confirmed strong binding affinities between these identified compounds and critical regulatory nodes within TGF-beta1/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin, suggesting a potential multi-target therapeutic mechanism. CONCLUSIONS: Our integrated approaches firstly documented EMT dysregulation by multiple makers in CRSsNP patients, and provided novel insights into SLTQP's anti-EMT effects through dual pathway modulation, supporting its application as a complementary CRS treatment strategy.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性鼻窦炎（CRS）作为一种常见的上呼吸道炎症性疾病，因其高复发率在临床管理中仍具挑战性。中医（TCM）发病理论认为，CRS主要源于涉及肺脾功能虚弱的虚证。参苓通气散（SLTQP），一种复方中药制剂，已在增强肺脾功能和缓解CRS症状方面显示出临床疗效，但其潜在药理机制需系统阐明。方法：收集鼻中隔偏曲及无鼻息肉慢性鼻窦炎（CRSsNP）患者的鼻黏膜，进行上皮-间质转化（EMT）的组织病理学分析。采用金黄色葡萄球菌建立CRS大鼠模型，记录体重、抓鼻次数和喷嚏次数。通过计算机断层扫描（CT）评估鼻窦炎症。应用组织病理学染色、逆转录定量实时聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和蛋白质印迹法评估大鼠及细胞模型中TGF-beta1/Smad和Wnt/beta-catenin信号通路及EMT。通过ELISA分析大鼠鼻灌洗液和血清中的炎症因子。采用LC-MS/MS分析SLTQP煎剂及含药血清。通过分子对接计算这些分子与TGF-beta1/Smad和Wnt/beta-catenin之间的能量，并利用表面等离子体共振（SPR）确认和量化直接结合亲和力。结果：组织病理学分析显示，CRSsNP患者鼻黏膜标本中EMT显著升高。SLTQP给药显著减轻CRS大鼠模型中的EMT进展并抑制鼻部炎症反应，可能通过同时抑制TGF-beta1/Smad和Wnt/beta-catenin信号级联介导。通过液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）的植物化学分析，表征了天然SLTQP煎剂成分及其在体循环中的生物活性代谢物。值得注意的是，分子对接分析预测并经SPR确认，这些鉴定化合物与TGF-beta1/Smad和Wnt/beta-catenin中的关键调控节点具有强结合亲和力，提示潜在的多靶点治疗机制。结论：我们的综合方法首次通过多种标志物记录了CRSsNP患者中的EMT失调，并为SLTQP通过双通路调节发挥抗EMT作用提供了新见解，支持其作为CRS补充治疗策略的应用。
